footnote_text: The Reporting Person was granted restricted stock units ("RSUs"), which each represent a contingent right to receive one share of ordinary stock of Ceragon Networks Ltd. (the "Company"). The RSUs vest in three annual installments, with 33.4% vesting on 11/04/2027 and 33.3% vesting on each of 11/04/2028 and 11/04/2029, subject to the Reporting Person's continued service to the Company or its subsidiaries through each vesting date.
